trial_court: Family Court, Kota - C.M. Case No.65/2011
case_name: Smt Sunita Suman vs Rajvir And Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: Rajveer @ Shafikur Rahman & Others (husband and others)

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed a petition under Sections 7, 12, and 21 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking a declaration that her marriage to respondent was void. The trial is proceeding at a slow pace despite attempts for reconciliation having failed.

legal_principles.principle: Once reconciliation has failed, the trial should be fast-tracked.
legal_principles.held: It was incumbent for the Family Court to fast track the trial once even reconciliation had failed.

legal_principles.principle: Adjournments should only be by way of reasoned orders with the object of a fair trial.
legal_principles.held: Adjournments should only be by way of reasoned orders with the object of a fair trial and not an instrument of harassment of the petitioning wife.

outcome.final_order: The Family Court, Kota shall conclude the trial within a period of four months from the next date.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955
guidelines for expedited trial in Family Court
